scope: Initial single-primary-display snapshot. Desktop HWND and NULL default selection only; other windows stop until Apple window geometry exists. No dynamic rotation, hotplug or secondary-monitor routing acceptance.
monitor_token_range: 0xc4000001..0xc4ffffff, derived from separately owned desktop tokens
geometry: Primary Apple backing pixels with top-left origin. macOS visibleFrame converted from bottom-left coordinates. Mobile guest desktop is fullscreen; HUD safe areas are a separate window concern.
device_name: \\.\DISPLAY1 is the guest primary display identity, not an Apple hardware name
